cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to eye level with the gripper pointing upward and performs a repetitive side-to-side waving motion to greet someone.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot raises its arm from a resting position to eye level with the gripper pointing upward, holding the position to signal a greeting or acknowledgement.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot lowers its arm and extends it slightly forward in a slow, weighted motion to simulate a formal bow, holding the position to show respect.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot orients its gripper vertically and reaches forward towards the user, holding the position to invite a handshake.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at waist height with a vertical gripper orientation and performs a rhythmic up-and-down shaking motion to simulate a handshake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves across its chest and pulls inward toward its torso, holding the position to simulate a self-embracing hug of comfort.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its mouth area, pauses briefly, and then sweeps the arm forward and upward to simulate blowing a kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm traces a large, recognizable heart shape above its head. It starts at the top center, curves around the left lobe, dips into a sharp bottom point, and returns through the right lobe.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot expresses sincerity or heartfelt gratitude by bringing its hand to the center of its chest. The gripper points toward the body (back) and holds the position to emphasize the gesture's meaning.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot quickly thrusts its arm upward with the gripper pointing up, then performs a series of rapid 'pumping' motions at the peak height to express triumph.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm to head level and then performs a sharp, high-speed downward 'pump' motion to signal triumph or agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves from a resting side position into a classic biceps flex pose, lifting the elbow and curling the wrist toward the head to signal strength and confidence.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot simulates a nodding gesture by positioning its gripper at head height and performing a repetitive up-and-down tilting motion using the wrist joint.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level and performs a quick, sharp side-to-side rotation to mimic a human head shaking 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot expresses uncertainty by lifting its arm into a shrug and rotating its gripper to a horizontal, palms-up position, holding the expressive pose to signal a lack of knowledge.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its gripper to the side of its head and performs a light, repetitive scratching motion to indicate uncertainty or confusion.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level to represent a head, then performs a slow, inquisitive lateral tilt of the wrist to simulate curiosity or questioning.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot expresses exasperation or embarrassment by quickly raising its gripper to its forehead level and holding it there, mimicking a human facepalm.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot arm rotates the gripper to point toward itself and moves it to the center of the chest to indicate 'self'.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm raises and extends sharply forward, pointing the gripper at the observer or a target object in an authoritative 'you' gesture.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing down and repeatedly curls its 'hand' toward itself to beckon someone to come closer.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly extends its arm forward with the gripper pointing up and the palm facing the viewer, holding the position firmly to signal a stop command.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm raises to eye level with the gripper pointing straight up, holding the position to emphasize a point or request a moment of patience.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot lifts its gripper vertically to its mouth level and holds it there in a steady position to signal for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot positions its gripper at stomach level, pointing inward toward its own torso, and executes a series of light, rhythmic taps to simulate the gesture of being hungry or full.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot reaches across its chest to the opposite upper arm and performs a rapid up-and-down rubbing motion to signal that it is cold or shivering.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its gripper to face level and performs a rapid, repetitive lateral fanning motion to signal it is feeling hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot simulates tiredness by slowly raising its gripper to the mouth area, orienting it to cover the 'face', and holding the position to represent a long yawn.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot raises its gripper to eye level and performs a repetitive lateral rubbing motion to simulate fatigue or wiping away sleep.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot performs a slow, deep bow by lowering its arm and leaning forward, holding the position to express sincere apology or deep respect.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level, oriented upwards, and executes two rapid downward wrist flicks to mimic the 'air quotes' gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its gripper to the side of its head at temple height and performs three quick tapping motions to signify thinking or being smart.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head and uses its wrist to trace small, rapid circles near the temple, a universal gesture for 'crazy' or 'eccentric'.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its mouth and performs a quick, horizontal sliding motion across its 'lips' to signal silence or a secret.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot moves its arm across its torso to a high-lateral position and pulls it tight against the chest to signal a defensive or closed-off stance.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves to the hip area with a firm, deliberate motion and holds the position to signal confidence, authority, or annoyance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot simulates leaning forward to show engagement. It extends its arm toward the user while lowering its height slightly and keeping the gripper horizontal to mimic open, receptive palms.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot reacts to a sudden stimulus by sharply retracting its arm toward its chest and raising the gripper with the 'palm' facing forward, followed by a brief startle jitter.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot reacts to a surprise or mistake by quickly bringing its gripper to its mouth area. The gripper is oriented vertically to mimic a palm covering the face, and it holds the position to emphasize the realization.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its hand to the midline at chest height with palms pressed together (vertical orientation), then performs a deliberate, slow bow by tilting the arm forward and down.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot lifts its gripper vertically to eye level as if holding a drink, performs a sharp forward nudge to simulate a toast, and holds the gesture briefly.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot raises its hand to eye level with the palm open and facing forward, holding the position to invite a high-five from the user.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot positions its arm high with the gripper pointing up and palm forward, then executes a sharp, high-speed downward swing to mimic a high-five slapping motion.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot raises its arm to chest height and extends its gripper forward in a vertical 'fist' orientation, holding the position to invite a fist bump from the user.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its gripper in a vertical 'fist' orientation at chest height and performs two quick, rhythmic forward taps to simulate a fist bump or hitting a palm.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot reaches over its shoulder and performs a series of rhythmic taps on its own upper back to signal self-encouragement or a job well done.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot positions its arm at eye level, pointing forward, then executes two full clockwise circles in the vertical plane to communicate the concept of 'again' or 'around'.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its neck with a horizontal orientation, then performs a sharp horizontal sweep across its throat and holds the final position to signal an immediate stop.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot positions its hand under its chin with the gripper pointing toward its neck, then performs a sharp outward flicking motion to signal dismissal or indifference.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its gripper at waist height pointing downwards, then performs a series of rapid, rhythmic wrist oscillations to simulate the impatient tapping of fingers on a surface.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm up) and performs a repetitive curling motion with the elbow to beckon or request an item.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot positions its hand near its chest with the palm facing up, then slowly extends the arm forward and slightly upward in a smooth, presenting gesture.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot arm quickly ascends to head level with the gripper pointing up and open, signaling submission or surrender.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the side of its head (temple area) and performs a pressing motion with its gripper to signal that a sound is too loud or that it is blocking out audio.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm starts centered at chest height and sweeps broadly outward and upward, holding an open position to signal a warm welcome or presentation.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot simulates a deep, relieving stretch by raising its arm high above its head and performing small tension movements at the peak of the reach.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the side of its head, placing the gripper near the temple in a sharp, formal salute and holding the position.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its arm to forehead level with a horizontal gripper orientation to simulate shading its eyes, then performs a slow lateral scan as if searching the distance.
